page.title: Bambu Usage Tracking
page.subtitle: Deducts the filament used by Bambu Lab prints from the matching FilaMan spools and keeps a print history with plate previews.
page.footer: FilaManBambuUsage, MIT. Consumption logic ported from OpenSpoolMan (MIT).

status.heading: Printers
status.none: No Bambu Lab printer found. Add one in FilaMan with the Bambu Lab driver.
status.needsRestart: The plugin is installed, but its endpoints do not answer yet. Restart FilaMan once and everything is there.

history.heading: Prints
history.none: No print recorded yet. The next one on a watched printer lands here.
history.edit: Change the spool or the amount
history.deleteExplain: Only the entry in this list goes. What was booked stays booked on the spool, because the filament was really used.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.autoSpend: Deduct automatically when a print finishes
settings.spendOnCancel: Deduct an aborted print at the share it got through
settings.retentionHint: 0 keeps everything. Plate previews are stored with the print, so this is what bounds the size of the database.

errors.databaseUnavailable: The plugin database is not available
errors.localesMissing: Translation files are missing from the installed plugin
errors.bookingFailed: The booking could not be carried out
errors.spoolsUnavailable: The spool list could not be loaded from FilaMan

diagnostics.heading: Help and diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: If a print is booked to the wrong spool or stays without its 3MF, send this text along with the question. It shows what the printers reported and how the plugin read it.
diagnostics.printIntro: What the printer reported when this print started, and how the plugin turned it into slots and spools.
diagnostics.privacy: Contains no access code, serial number or IP address. The names of the print files are included.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy. The text is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
diagnostics.fits: {count} characters, fits in one Discord message
diagnostics.tooLong: {count} characters, too long for one Discord message. Download the file and attach it instead.
diagnostics.loadFailed: The diagnostics text could not be loaded.
